pack.title: Rejecting gracefully
pack.description: Decline another date with kindness and clarity.

scenarios.setting: After a first date, the other person asks to meet again and you are not interested.
scenarios.jab: When can I see you again?
scenarios.goal: Decline another date with kindness and clarity.

replies.line: I enjoyed meeting you. I don't feel a romantic connection.
replies.why: It gives a clear answer without inventing a reason or promising another date.
replies.delivery: Keep the tone kind but avoid a questioning ending or a promise to reconsider.

replies.line: Thanks for meeting. I won't pursue this.
replies.why: It closes the romantic invitation without evaluating the other person's worth.
replies.delivery: Keep the tone kind but avoid a questioning ending or a promise to reconsider.

replies.line: Thank you for the evening; I don't feel the connection I'm looking for, and I wish you well.
replies.why: It acknowledges the shared time while making the decision unambiguous.
replies.delivery: Keep the tone kind but avoid a questioning ending or a promise to reconsider.

followUp.jab: Can we just try one more time?
followUp.line: I understand you're disappointed; my decision is the same.
followUp.why: It acknowledges the feeling without negotiating your lack of interest.
followUp.delivery: Keep the tone kind but avoid a questioning ending or a promise to reconsider.
